scope: new production training; old R5/R6/R7 source, models and diagnostics preserved
reference_cv_semantics: all admitted509 vessel-role references shared in every background TRAIN fold; no reference-independent CV claim
background_cv_semantics: original allowed100965 public SA window pool; source-group5fold, other4buckets TRAIN before24h support purge; heldout groups separate selection/ensemble_fit/ensemble_gate/report

hard_negative_policy.definition: TRAIN-only R6 low0..8 bump >=TRAIN q90 and low >max(safe15..22,high20..24)+3dB; heuristic, not natural-vessel truth
hard_negative_policy.selection: prefer candidates for half of no-source requests without primary duplication; if candidates insufficient use all, fill remaining zero slots deterministically

generator.placement_conditioning: native minute geometry only, independent of background observation mask
generator.scale_reference: whole EQ-transformed native complete-minute trajectory peak before crop and masking
generator.ambient_controls: separate analysis panel; known ambient-added energy is not relabelled as vessel-only energy or automatic zero target

training.mixed_precision: CUDA BF16 with FP32 pooling; CPU only for explicit fixtures
training.checkpoint_policy: strict best-window, best-macro, last, every10epochs; full epoch log

ensemble.fallback: best single neural member on ensemble_fit groups
ensemble.admission: choose one candidate on ensemble_fit, evaluate once versus fallback on separate ensemble_gate groups

inference.execution_status: after production checkpoints and every fold policy are frozen
inference.fold_aggregation: equal arithmetic mean over all five complete fold policies
inference.share: same-policy nonnegative simplex member average, then equal fold mean
inference.score: same frozen member weights for diagnostic scores, then equal fold mean

execution.tree_executor: Mac CPU in separately verified stage; no implicit server tree fitting
execution.report_access: only after every requested fold checkpoint and ensemble policy is frozen
